comments.author: lbotos
comments.story: Ammonium chloride tastes like nothing else. It may be the sixth basic taste
comments.text: wat. Did you watch the same video? [VIDEO] Here's a simple test you can try yourself: put some food in your mouth and hold your nose. What do you taste? Now do it again with your nose not blocked. Try this for various foods. I got this from Science and Cooking: [LINK] The first chapter talks about how aroma is a component of flavor and you can use this test to identify if your ingredients are giving you taste (tongue) or aroma molecules (nose)
